summary.goal: Display and link to artifacts produced by the run. Artifacts are references to external resources (PRs, commits, deployments).

acceptance_criteria.description: List artifacts grouped by type (Pull Requests, Commits, Deployments, Files)
External links open in new tab (GitHub PR, deployment URL)
Associated task ID shown for each artifact
Status badge for PRs (open, merged, closed)
Artifacts section in run summary after completion
Copy link button for easy sharing
PR status refresh with stale indicator after 5 minutes

observations: Status badges require GitHub API or similar integration
Grouped display helps users find what they need
PR status can become stale - need refresh strategy

pr_status_refresh.strategy: Piggyback on run SSE events - status updated when run events arrive
pr_status_refresh.stale_indicator: Show 'Last checked N min ago' after 5 minutes without update
pr_status_refresh.manual_refresh: Refresh button to explicitly re-fetch PR status
pr_status_refresh.implementation: Backend includes pr_status in artifact metadata, refreshed on task events

steps.title: Create artifacts API module
steps.description: API functions for fetching run artifacts

acceptance_criteria.description: getRunArtifacts(runId) returns { artifacts: Artifact[] }
Artifact type: { artifact_id, task_id, type, reference, metadata, created_at }
ArtifactType: 'commit' | 'pr' | 'file' | 'deployment' | 'test_result'
refreshPRStatus(artifactId) returns updated artifact with fresh metadata

specification.notes: Artifacts are nested in run response, not a separate endpoint

acceptance_criteria.description: Maps type to icon: commit -> GitCommitIcon, pr -> GitPullRequestIcon, file -> FileIcon, deployment -> RocketIcon, test_result -> TestTubeIcon
Size variants: sm, md, lg
Default icon for unknown types

steps.title: Create ArtifactItem component
steps.description: Single artifact row with link and actions

acceptance_criteria.description: ArtifactTypeIcon on left
Title/reference as external link (target=_blank)
Task title as secondary text
Status badge for PRs (if metadata includes status)
Copy link button on hover
Created timestamp (relative: '5m ago')

design.item: flex items-center gap-3 p-2 hover:bg-bg-tertiary rounded-lg

steps.title: Create PRStatusBadge component with stale indicator
steps.description: Badge showing PR status with staleness tracking

acceptance_criteria.description: Status values: open (green outline), merged (purple fill), closed (red)
Small badge with status text
Reads status from artifact.metadata.status
Stale indicator: 'Last checked N min ago' tooltip after 5 min
Optional refresh button on hover when stale

design.stale_indicator: Muted text, clock icon, tooltip with last_updated timestamp

stale_logic.display: Show 'Checked Xm ago' when now - status_updated_at > threshold

steps.title: Create ArtifactGroup component
steps.description: Collapsible group of artifacts by type

acceptance_criteria.description: Header with type icon, name, count
Collapsible content area
Default expanded for PRs and deployments
ArtifactItem for each artifact in group

steps.title: Create ArtifactsPanel component with refresh button
steps.description: Full artifacts list panel with manual refresh option

acceptance_criteria.description: Header: 'Artifacts (N)'
ArtifactGroups for each type present
Order: PRs first, then deployments, commits, files, test results
Empty state: 'No artifacts produced yet'
Refresh button in header to manually refresh all PR statuses
Loading state on refresh button during refresh

design.refresh_button: ghost style, RefreshCw icon, ml-auto in header

steps.title: Integrate into TaskItem expanded view
steps.description: Show task artifacts in expanded task details

acceptance_criteria.description: Artifacts section in TaskItem expanded view
Shows artifacts for that specific task only
Hidden if task has no artifacts

specification.integration: Modify frd-s2 TaskItem to include artifacts in expanded view

steps.title: Add to run completion summary
steps.description: Show all artifacts when run completes

acceptance_criteria.description: ArtifactsPanel shown prominently for completed runs
Positioned below progress bar on dashboard
Highlighted section: 'Run Complete - Artifacts Produced'

specification.integration: Modify frd-s8 RunDashboardPage to show artifacts section for completed runs

steps.title: Implement SSE-based status updates
steps.description: Update artifact status via run SSE events

acceptance_criteria.description: Listen for artifact_updated event in run SSE stream
Update artifact metadata in local state on event
Reset stale indicator when fresh status arrives
Track last_updated timestamp for staleness calculation

architecture.pattern: Piggyback on existing run SSE subscription
architecture.event: artifact_updated or included in task_completed event
architecture.state_update: Merge new metadata into existing artifact in local state
